articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Foxglove Heights Neighbors
body: To the editor: Please keep the pocket park in the budget. Many of us on Maple Road use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Maple Road for 36 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foxglove Heights Neighbors has made.
Quentin Wojcik, Eastgate
